record.question: Which of the following is false regarding PKI infrastructure?
options: Controller of Certifying Authorities(CCA) licence and regulate working of Certifying Authorities
Licensed Certifying Authorities can issue Digital Signature Certificates to end users
Registration Authorities are authorized by CA to certify the public key of the subscriber
Subscribers are end users who apply for Digital Signature Certificates to Licensed CA
record.explanation: Registration authorities do not certify public keys.
